### CVE-2019-25745 — WordPress Plugin Google Review Slider 6.1 SQL Injection via tid
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-06-04 | Updated: 2026-07-28 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-89 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.2 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

WordPress Plugin Google Review Slider 6.1 contains a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the 'tid' parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to the admin interface with malicious 'tid' values to extract sensitive database information using time-based blind SQL injection techniques.

Affected:
- jgwhite33 / Google Review Slider: affected 6.1

Credits: Princy Edward

References:
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/47567 [exploit]
- https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-google-places-review-slider/ [product]
- https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/wordpress-plugin-google-review-slider-sql-injection-via-tid [third-party-advisory]
